name: ujam-beatmaker-style
notes: UJAM Beatmaker in Style mode: Beatmaker plays its own phrases and the track becomes held song-part keys, one per section (Latch OFF — a phrase plays while its key is held). Key layout from the Beatmaker 2.1 User Guide, 'Keyboard Layout: Style' (MIDI 60 = C3 in UJAM's naming): Verse 1-5 = 60, 62, 64, 65, 67; Intro 1-2 = 61, 63; Fill 1-3 = 66, 68, 70; Chorus 1-5 = 69, 71, 72, 74, 76; End 1-2 = 73, 75; Special 1-3 = 77, 79, 81; Breakdown 1-3 = 78, 80, 82; Off = 83. Repeated sections step through the numbered variations (verse2 → Verse 2); sections with fills get a Fill key on their last beat; the song ends on End 1. Layouts vary slightly between titles. Pick the Style in the plugin; its BPM hint is only a suggestion.
